title: Gpipe: Efficient training of giant neural networks using pipeline parallelism

numbers.sentence: Furthermore, we show that equipped with the recent proposed weight sharing mechanism in ENAS to reduce the large complexity in the parameter space of child models, we can achieve improved efficiency in discovering powerful convolutional and recurrent architectures, e.g., both take less than hours on 1 GPU.
We use 200 V100 GPU cards to complete all the process within 1 day.
For the second setting, we exactly follow the setup of ENAS and the search process includes running 150 epochs on 1 V100 GPU for hours.
We use P100 GPU cards to complete all the process within 1.5 days.
